protocol.execution_order_algorithm: ascending SHA256(ASCII(seed + '/' + scope + '/' + task + '/' + arm + '/repeat-' + repeat))
protocol.scoring: score_benchmark_attempt.py: original base commit, official tests, immutable image, independent cold oracle
protocol.input_policy: identical qualified task, native legacy prompt and tool schemas; retain and compare actual first request identities
protocol.usage_policy: all registered trials; unknown usage is missing; observed-only mean separately labelled
protocol.paired_analysis: task x repeat; each treatment minus baseline; retain missing pairs; descriptive only
protocol.history_policy: qualification and task identities only; previous model outcomes excluded
protocol.source_policy: freeze source and protocol hashes per run; all full trials share one manifest
